description: Generate precise Bazi (八字) charts from solar or lunar date-times for personality insights and destiny forecasting. Retrieve Chinese calendar (Huangli) details for any date and discover possible Gregorian times for a given Bazi. Rely on accurate calculations to avoid common charting errors.
